_meta.source: GSTN Returns Offline Tool v3.2.4 (utility/returnStructure.js build side, service/offline.js post-processing, utility/jsonToExcel.js read/export side, utility/common.js formDataFormat, public/data/*.json enumerations, and public/pages/returns/upload|error Angular summary templates)
caveats: cdnur (VERIFIER DISAGREEMENT, corrected): itm_det for cdnur carries ONLY {txval, rt, iamt, csamt}. Unlike cdnr there is NO intra-state branch, so camt/samt are NEVER emitted. The original extraction incorrectly listed camt/samt at cdnur[].itms[].itm_det; both keys were removed per returnStructure.js:3196-3206 (single cdnur/cdnura itemFn), jsonToExcel.js:3959-3972 (camt/samt reads commented out for cdnur), and tool cdnur.csv having no Central/State tax columns.

cdnur: sp_typ is a disabled UI-only Angular select (summary.html:161-164, ng-disabled=true) and is NOT part of the authoritative GSTR-1 cdnur submission JSON (sp_typ only appears in the GSTR-2 builders). Excluded from _fields and _skeleton.

Tax-amount mutual exclusivity: in b2b, b2cl, b2cs, cdnr and cdnur an intra-state line carries {camt, samt} and an inter-state line carries {iamt} — never both. b2b/b2cl/cdnr skeletons that show them together (or only one) do so for key-vocabulary completeness; a real line emits EITHER {camt,samt} OR {iamt}. csamt (cess) is present in both branches.

diff_percent: only the value 0.65 (65% of the existing rate) survives to the uploaded JSON in every section; any other value is stripped. It is stored as a FRACTION (0.65), not a percent. In b2cs it is additionally deleted when it equals 1 or is falsy.

chksum (b2b) and flag/chksum (b2cl, b2cs, cdnr) are edit / error-correction (import) flow metadata read from the 'Mandatory Check Field' column; they are NOT part of a fresh prepared upload payload. Treated as optional.

cname (b2b, cdnr) is display/import metadata. cdnr strips it via removeCName() before the final GSTR-1 upload JSON; b2b reads it back on export, so it is retained as optional. Other transient builder keys (diffval, status, supplierRecipientName, cfs, updby, ref_key, error_cd, error_msg, old_inum, old_ntnum, opd, d_flag, cflag, rsn) are UI/import metadata and are NOT canonical upload keys.
cdnr/cdnur are CDN-delinked (tool release 2.4): the invoice-reference keys inum, idt and the pre-GST flag p_gst are explicitly deleted from the final note JSON (offline.js removePOS/cleanCDN).
hsn: the final-JSON uqc is the SHORT code only (e.g. 'KGS', 'PCS', 'BAG'); the UI/Excel 'KGS-Kilograms' form is split on '-' and only [0] is kept (offline.js fixUQC). 'NA' passes through unchanged.

hsn: user_desc (taxpayer free-text description) appears ONLY in bifurcated hsn_b2b/hsn_b2c rows and is not stripped, so it persists into the tool-generated file. Confidence that GSTN's own schema formally accepts user_desc is LOWER than for the other keys; treat as a tool-carried field (desc = standardized 'Description as per HSN Code').

hsn: legacy pre-052025 files use a single hsn.data[] array (no hsn_b2b/hsn_b2c). In legacy data[] rt is present only in the newer rate-wise sub-branch and val only in the older value-wise sub-branch; bifurcated rows carry BOTH rt and val.

rate.json (VERIFIER presentation correction): each rate is stored as an object {"value": N}, not a bare scalar. The numeric values enumerated in _rules.rates are exact; only the array-of-objects wrapper was abbreviated.

doc_num: the build path (returnStructure.js:1604) maps 1-based via docDetails.indexOf(name)+1. The Excel read path (jsonToExcel.js:4448) reads docDetails[doc_num] 0-based, an off-by-one that mislabels the export only; it does not change the JSON key shape.
All GSTR-1 sections were reported at HIGH confidence by both the extractor and the independent verifier.

hsn_legacy_pre_052025.note: For return periods BEFORE fp '052025' the hsn section is a single legacy 'data' array (NO hsn_b2b/hsn_b2c and NO user_desc).

b2cl_invoice_value_threshold.operator: An invoice is INVALID/dropped when Invoice Value <= limit; a VALID B2CL/B2CLA invoice requires value STRICTLY GREATER THAN the limit (>), not >=
b2cl_invoice_value_threshold.period_comparison: fp is stored MMYYYY and reordered to YYYYMM via fp.substring(2)+fp.substring(0,2); if < 202408 the limit is 250000, else 100000
b2cl_invoice_value_threshold.rounding: raw numeric compare with <= (no Math.round/toFixed on the value), so values 100000.01-100000.49 (and 250000.01-250000.49) correctly exceed the integer limit and are retained

rates.storage_shape: public/data/rate.json stores each rate as an OBJECT {"value": N}, not a bare scalar

ntty_enum.note: C=Credit note, D=Debit note; the cdnr dropdown additionally allows R

b2cs_enums.note: typ 'E' (E-Commerce) is currently commented out in the UI dropdown; real files emit 'OE', but 'E' remains valid and requires etin

doc_num_codes.2: Invoices for inward supply from unregistered person
doc_num_codes.10: Delivery Challan for supply on approval
doc_num_codes.11: Delivery Challan in case of liquid gas
doc_num_codes.12: Delivery Challan in case other than by way of supply (excluding at S no. 9 to 11)

state_pos_codes.range: 01-38 with NO code 28 (27 Maharashtra jumps to 29 Karnataka); includes 37 Andhra Pradesh, 38 Ladakh, 25 Daman and Diu, 26 Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

cdn_reason_codes_rsn.note: rsn does NOT appear in the final GSTR-1 outward cdnr/cdnur upload JSON; these codes back the CDN reason dropdown / GSTR-2 layout only

_rules.gstin_regex_source: directives1.4.js:330 (v3.2.4); older directives1.1.js:282 used a stricter [Z]{1} in the 14th position; ng-pattern anchors it implicitly

gt_cur_gt.omission: both keys are omitted entirely from the top-level JSON when gt isNaN

_rules.diff_percent_rule: Only the value 0.65 (65% of the existing rate) survives to the uploaded JSON in every section; stored as a FRACTION; any other value is stripped. In b2cs it is additionally deleted when == 1 or falsy
_rules.uqc_rule: hsn final JSON stores the SHORT UQC code only (split on '-' from the UI 'CODE-Name' form; e.g. 'KGS-Kilograms' -> 'KGS'); 'NA' passes through unchanged
_rules.cdn_delinking: cdnr/cdnur are CDN-delinked (tool release 2.4): inum, idt and p_gst are deleted from the final note JSON
